name: g1_viewer_full
_doc: G1 milestone-gate config: the full 10x10x5 m domain at h=5 cm (200x200x100 = 4M cells) with a 1 m cylinder. Demonstrates the milestone's 60 fps slice view at h=5 cm: rendering is decoupled from the (heavier, ~tens-of-ms) physics step, so the viewer holds display rate while the sim advances on the worker thread. Heavier than the bundled gate config (g1_viewer.json), so not used by the automated gate_G1.
